title: Curiosity, made collective.
lead: Spectrum DTU is an engineering and research team at Delhi Technological University.
paragraphs: We bring students together to explore telecommunications, 5G, embedded systems and emerging technology. It is a space to ask better questions, experiment with ideas and develop the skills to build what comes next.
Through peer collaboration and hands-on learning, students can connect technical understanding with practical exploration — from circuits and networks to prototypes and research.
